about: Golden set (#2533, plan step 3): frozen, versioned, append-only cases with known answers, measured by src/lib/agents/deming/golden-set.ts (measureGoldenSet: recall = expected fees on the source the pipeline publishes / expected fees on the source; precision = right publications / publications whose rightness is known). Shadow-lab members name their committed fixture and the sha256 of the document text, and freeze their expected fees here. Regression members freeze the confirmed takedown's check input. Answer-key bank members name an answer key whose reference was eligible under a real score run (receipt event id and key fingerprint); their text is read from source_documents/agent_source_texts by content hash and they are skipped offline. Never edit or remove a member: append a new version with GOLDEN_SET_APPEND=1 (golden-set.test.ts) and pin it in GOLDEN_SET_VERSIONS.
